description.p: Pyrite is a small Python IDE inspired by PyCharm. It starts quickly, keeps PyCharm's keymap and dark colour scheme, and stays out of the way.

ul.li: Project tree with create, rename and move-to-trash
Tabbed editor with Python, JSON and Markdown highlighting, and autosave
Run console that accepts stdin and turns traceback lines into links
Integrated terminal that activates the project's virtualenv
Interpreter detection for .venv, venv and env, or pick your own
Go to File and Go to Line

description.p: Pyrite needs a Python interpreter to run your code. Install your distribution's python3 package if you do not have one already.
First release: project tree, editor, run console and terminal.
